description: Header file defining the LocalizationSettings class, which manages locale-specific formatting and localization details for the calculator app, including number formatting, locale info, and calendar settings.

classes.name: LocalizationSettings
classes.description: A singleton class that provides locale-specific formatting, digit, calendar, and separator information for the calculator app.

methods.name: GetInstance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of LocalizationSettings.

methods.name: IsDigitEnUsSetting
methods.description: Checks if the digit symbols correspond to en-US settings.

methods.name: GetEnglishValueFromLocalizedDigits
methods.description: Converts localized digit string to English digits.

methods.name: RemoveGroupSeparators
methods.description: Removes group separators and spaces from a string.

methods.name: GetCalendarIdentifier
methods.description: Returns the calendar identifier based on locale.

methods.name: GetFirstDayOfWeek
methods.description: Returns the first day of the week according to locale.

methods.name: GetCurrencyTrailingDigits
methods.description: Returns the number of trailing digits for currency formatting.

methods.name: GetCurrencySymbolPrecedence
methods.description: Returns the precedence of the currency symbol.

methods.name: GetDigitSymbolFromEnUsDigit
methods.description: Returns the localized digit symbol for a given en-US digit.

methods.name: IsEnUsDigit
methods.description: Checks if a character is an en-US digit.

methods.name: IsLocalizedDigit
methods.description: Checks if a character is a localized digit.

methods.name: IsLocalizedHexDigit
methods.description: Checks if a character is a localized hexadecimal digit.

methods.name: GetListSeparatorWinRT
methods.description: Returns the list separator as a WinRT string.

methods.name: GetDecimalSeparatorStrWinRT
methods.description: Returns the decimal separator as a WinRT string.
